traits.name: steady
traits.reason: Mostly repeated stone gathers, two per tile across two tiles, but one wood gather strays from the stone/ore job and the pack-full outcome is unseen.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: Only short moves of 1-2 tiles; no long walk to a mountain edge or any ore gathering is visible.

traits.name: exact
traits.reason: No public lines naming tiles or counts; the actions alone give no stated coordinates or loads.

traits.name: gruff
traits.reason: Says nothing at all, which is terse, but there is no grunt of a line at a stocked store to show the trait.

traits.name: sparing
traits.reason: Nothing shows five being left on any node; the repeated gathers move on after two, so the evidence is inconclusive.
